verdict.rationale: The docs describe NPM packages for all modules, ES6 module support and a modular, tree-shakable ES6 design. A runtime probe confirms @babylonjs/core is published on the public npm registry (v9.26.1, Apache-2.0, about 234K weekly downloads), so it installs and imports like any dependency. One community comment says the engine is large and needs bandwidth optimization, but nothing concretely shows tree-shaking failing. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that tree-shaking meaningfully reduces bundle size in a real bundler setup.
